name: EMERALD LOOP
address: 1012 SE CLEVELAND SQ LP STE 2, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street in both directions.
• Keep the rear access point unlocked and clear of vehicles or stored items to allow responders to reach the back of the property.
• Trim vegetation that grows against or overhangs the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move along exterior walls.
• Clear a walking path between the main residence and the detached structure wide enough for two responders to pass with equipment.
• Mark or label the secondary access point so arriving responders can quickly identify all entry options without searching the property perimeter.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Near Structure; Scattered Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Multiple Access Routes; Grass Cover
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly next to the house to create open space between the plants and the structure.
• Remove or cut back grass cover close to the house and any outbuildings to reduce the amount of burnable material near the walls.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so their branches do not touch or hang over the roof or walls.
• Separate any shrub clusters that connect the open terrain vegetation to the structure, breaking up the continuous path of plants leading to the house.
• Keep grass mowed short in the open areas surrounding the structure, particularly during dry seasons.
• Trim tree branches that overhang the driveway to keep both access routes clear for vehicles.
• Remove dead or dry grass and shrub material that has accumulated against the base of the structure.
• Keep the areas between scattered tree groupings and the house clear of low shrubs and tall grass that could carry fire from the open terrain to the structure.
